title: PulseGrid latency sentry: p50/p95/p99 by model & route (streaming vs non-streaming)
creator: Sofia Kim
description:
Objective: Build a consolidated dashboard (PulseGrid) that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency for every model-route pair, with a clear streaming vs non-streaming breakdown, integrated trace hooks, and links to the underlying telemetry pipeline. This ticket covers the dashboard panels, query definitions, alert thresholds, and tracing/trace-link instrumentation necessary for SREs and platform engineers to diagnose regressions quickly.

Background: We currently have multiple ad-hoc latency views (per-route sparklines, cohort boards, and a handful of trace links). Investigations show regressions are often missed because streaming and non-streaming requests are aggregated. PulseGrid will make I/O-mode-split first-class so teams can see percentile divergence immediately and jump to traces.

Goals:
- One board with sortable rows for model family / model version / route.
- Columns for p50, p95, p99 over selectable windows (1h/6h/24h).
- Streaming and non-streaming columns side-by-side with delta and heatmap cell coloring.
- Per-cell drilldown to cohort filter and direct trace links (trace-id anchor) for top tail samples.
- Backend query definitions (Prometheus + ClickHouse hybrid) and pre-aggregation rules to keep dashboard queries <2s for 1h window.
- Alerting rules for p95 and p99 deltas (absolute and relative) with playbook runbook link.

Out of scope: full multivariate decomposition (e.g., request_shape-level breakdowns) — that will be follow-up work once PulseGrid is stable.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exists in Console under Observability > PulseGrid and is permissioned to internal teams.
For any model-route row, dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for streaming and non-streaming with a delta column and cell heat colors.
Clicking a percentile cell opens a cohort drawer listing top 20 tail traces with direct trace links to Trace UI.
Queries respond under 2s for the default 1h window for the entire page load under typical production telemetry load.
Two alert rules in Alerting: (1) absolute p95 > threshold for a route, (2) relative p99 regression > 30% vs baseline; both trigger the latency playbook.
Instrumentation added: trace hook in serving runtime emits trace anchor id at tail sampling points for both streaming and non-streaming paths.
Telemetry pipeline cost increase < 8% for additional aggregations; document cost impact in the ticket thread.
tasks: Define Prometheus metrics & ClickHouse aggregates needed (p50/p95/p99 split by model, route, io_mode).
Add trace hook in runtime to annotate sampled tail events with trace-anchor and route metadata (eng: runtime team).
Implement ClickHouse rollup job for 1m buckets of percentiles grouped by (model, model_version, route, io_mode).
Build dashboard panels in Console: table + heatmap cells + cohort drawer + timeline sparkline per-row.
Add alerting rules and wire to the existing latency runbook; create dedicated Slack channel for alerts during rollout.
Load testing: validate dashboard query latency with synthetic telemetry at 3x baseline and iterate indices/aggregates.
PR + code review: implement instrumentation and ClickHouse DDL changes; link PRs in comments.
